name: AIM Vaccine Co., Ltd.
summary: AIM Vaccine Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of vaccine products for human use in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company's product pipeline includes tetravalent meningococcal conjugate vaccine, which is in phase IV clinical trial for meningococcal disease 13-Valent pneumonia conjugate and 23-valent pneumonia polysaccharide vaccine to treat pneumonia; iterative serum-free rabies vaccine; and bivalent Delta-Omicron BA.5 mRNA COVID-19 vaccine that is in phase III clinical trial to treat COVID-19 infection.
